steps.en: Requests that fail the automatic checks are flagged for manual review
steps.id: Permintaan yang gagal pengecekan otomatis ditandai untuk review manual

steps.en: The request is recorded as pending with the reason for review
steps.id: Permintaan dicatat sebagai pending beserta alasan review

steps.en: The portal side also shows the request as pending
steps.id: Sisi portal juga menampilkan permintaan sebagai pending

steps.en: All furnished details are available for the officer to read
steps.id: Semua detail yang diberikan tersedia untuk dibaca officer

steps.en: The proof documents can be opened by the officer
steps.id: Dokumen bukti dapat dibuka oleh officer

steps.en: A work item is created holding the notice and the furnished details
steps.id: Work item dibuat berisi notice dan detail yang diberikan
steps.why_en: No separate work item exists; only a pending record on the notice, and the work item menu is switched off.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item tersendiri; hanya catatan pending pada notice, dan menu work item dimatikan.

steps.en: The item shows up on the officer's own dashboard
steps.id: Item muncul di dashboard milik officer
steps.why_en: All permitted staff see one shared pending list; nothing assigns an item to one officer.
steps.why_id: Semua staff yang berhak melihat satu daftar pending bersama; tidak ada penugasan ke satu officer.
